#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll powmod(ll x, ll a) {
    if (a == 0) return 1;
    ll t = powmod(x, a / 2);
    t = (t * t) % MOD;
    if (a % 2 != 0) {
        t = (t * x) % MOD;
    }
    return t;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << powmod(p, p - 1) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << powmod(p, p) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    ll at = k;
    ll ord = 1;
    while (at != 1) {
        at = (at * k) % p;
        ++ord;
    }

    cout << powmod(p, (p - 1) / ord) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
